trait.description: You have 50 percent resistance to the damage type associated with your specific dragon ancestry.

On your turn when you take the Attack action, you can replace one of the attacks with your Breath Weapon. Targets in the area defined by your dragon ancestry make a Dexterity saving throw against DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Constitution modifier. A failed save deals damage of your dragon ancestry's type; a successful save takes half damage. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus and all expended uses return after a Long Rest.

originComposition.notes: Player-directed inheritance may choose the complete ordinary Breath Weapon area and its damage type from eligible configured contributor offers. Preserve one complete action, damage progression, save, and use pool. This does not independently authorize a mixed trait grant or confer resistance, warding, or other Dragonborn adaptations.
